blocks.text: Peperpot Nature Park: morning and evening birdwatching

provenance.rationale: The website heading combines the park name with the two birdwatching outings described in the Word itinerary.

blocks.text:
In the morning, you'll head out along the old avenues and forest trails of Peperpot Nature Park. The first hours after sunrise are especially good for birdwatching, when many tropical birds are active.

Look for manakins and flycatchers in the middle layers of the forest. You can often pick them out as they dart between branches.

You'll have time to relax by the pool during the heat of the day. Towards evening, you'll return to the park's trails. The hours before sunset offer another chance to add to your list of sightings.

Included today: transfers, guide services and accommodation at Hotel Peperpot.

blocks.text: Noordwijkweg and Weg Naar Zee: scarlet ibis and coastal birds

provenance.rationale: The website title uses the route names and target species documented in the corresponding Word heading and text.

blocks.text:
You'll set off early, before the heat of the day, with a light breakfast to take along.

The first part of the day is in the Noordwijkweg area. One of the birds to look for is the crimson-hooded manakin, a small bird with a bright crimson hood. Look for it along forest edges and in secondary forest.

Then you'll head to the coast at Weg Naar Zee to look for scarlet ibis. At the right time, large flocks take flight above the shore and mangroves.

Included today: transfers, guide services and accommodation at Hotel Peperpot.
